title: 2015 AMC 8 Problem 24
statement:
A baseball league consists of two four-team divisions. Each team plays every other team in its division \(N\) games. Each team plays every team in the other division \(M\) games with \(N > 2M\) and \(M > 4.\) Each team plays a \(76\) game schedule.

How many games does a team play within its own division?

solutions.text:
Each team plays \(3N\) games within its own division and \(4M\) games against the other division, so \[3N+4M=76.\]

Since \(N>2M,\) we have \(3N>6M,\) and hence \(76=3N+4M>10M.\) Thus \(M<7.6.\) Together with \(M>4,\) this gives \(M\in\{5,6,7\}.\)

Reducing \(3N+4M=76\) modulo \(3\) gives \(M\equiv1\pmod3,\) so \(M=7.\) Therefore the team plays \(4M=28\) non-division games and \(76-28=48\) division games.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
